Maria P.: Quick sync — we need to finalize onboarding SLAs, bench thresholds, and the deprecation/migration flow for new catalog models. Big customer asks for pinned-version guarantees and explicit migration windows. Can we align on criteria and owners?

Samir R.: Proposed onboarding gates: perf bench (P50 <= 150ms, P95 <= 400ms @ 2k tokens), cost cap (cost/token <= 1.8x baseline), quality (eval-suite pass >= 92% vs baseline), and API compatibility smoke tests.

Jess L.: +1. Add embedding drift metric: cosine drift < 0.03 on our anchor set. For generative models, hallucination rate < 4% on 200 challenge prompts. If automated checks are borderline, require a 50-sample human eval.

Leah K.: UX constraints: deprecation notices = 60/30/7 days with migration guide + example prompts and config snippets. Console should show a banner and an auto-link to the suggested replacement.

Nate B.: From support: need a clear rollback command and a migration flag per customer. Suggest canary path 5% -> 20% traffic over 48h, and automatic rollback if error_rate increases >1.5x baseline or SLO breach.

Samir R.: Rollout criteria summary: canary 24–72h, metrics to watch = error_rate, latency_p95, quality_eval_score. Blocking regressions: quality drop > 1.5% absolute or error_rate > 1.5x. Latency can increase up to +20% only if quality improves >= 2 points on our evals.

Maria P.: Decision proposal: adopt above as v1 policy. Owners: Samir (perf gating + rollout infra), Jess (eval suite + quality thresholds), Leah (docs + UX banners), Nate (support runbook + rollback), Oliver (security sign-off). Target: RFC + checklist by 2026-04-02.

Oliver H.: Security note — for Private/VPC deployments ensure deprecation notices respect local KMS/HSM policies and that key rotation timelines are communicated in the migration guide.

CatalogBot: Auto-note: checklist ticket created -> CAT-449 (model-catalog lifecycle checklist) when owners confirmed.

Maria P.: Ack. I'll open the RFC and include the canary steps + thresholds snippet below so eng can start implementing the gating hooks.

Maria P.: ```yaml
pin_policy:
  allow_pin: true
  pin_duration_days: 90
  migration_notice_days: [60, 30, 7]
  canary_steps:
    - percent: 5
      duration_hours: 24
    - percent: 20
      duration_hours: 48
regression_thresholds:
  quality_drop_pct: 1.5
  latency_increase_pct: 20
```

Samir R.: I'll prototype a test harness to automate bench runs and emit the gating metrics. Jess — can you land the eval prompt pack by EOW?

Jess L.: On it. Will upload the 200-challenge prompts + embedding anchors by Friday.

Nate B.: I'll draft the support playbook and the exact rollback command (with runbook steps).

Leah K.: I'll draft the deprecation email templates and console banner copy. We should include a migration checklist for customers (example prompts, expected deltas, cost impact).

Maria P.: Great. Next sync Thursday 11:00 to review the RFC draft. :calendar:
